game.name: Refunct
game.rules:
Use of any glitch that pauses the game or creates lag (alt-space, clicking the window tab) is not allowed. 

Use of the Refunct Texture Tool to change textures is allowed. However there are a few restrictions.
Do not change time of day before or during runs.
Do not set the emissiveness too high to the point where it obstructs vision in any way.
Do not have the uncoloured and coloured platforms to be the same colour.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the game

Video proof is required, including hitting New Game to start the run and showing the in-game time upon completion.

Beat the game with 100% completion

Video proof is required, including hitting New Game to start the run and showing the in-game time upon completion.

categories.name: Low%
categories.rules:
Beat the game with the lowest possible platform count.

The run must end with a maximum of 33% completion.  
Collecting a cube invalidates the run.

Video proof is required, including hitting New Game to start the run and showing the in-game time upon completion.

categories.name: All Cubes
categories.rules:
Complete the game and collect all 18 cubes

Video proof is required, including hitting New Game to start the run and showing the in-game time upon completion.

values.rules:
When submitting a run, put your IGT in both time fields.  
Then, enter the number of platforms above 38 as the hours digit in the IGT field.

New Game Glitch is not allowed.

values.name: New Game Glitch
values.rules:
When submitting a run, put your IGT in both time fields.  
Then, enter the number of platforms above 35 as the hours digit in the IGT field.

The run must include New Game Glitch.  Don't do it while coloring a platform, otherwise it'll be added to your platform count.
